bugs_found: transfer compares amount directly without normalizing/validating Decimal, so float inputs can raise TypeError or allow non-finite/invalid numeric types inconsistently versus other functions
transfer mutates debit before credit; if account_to.balance addition fails or is trapped, balances become inconsistent and no rollback occurs
transfer only blocks object identity self-transfer; two Account objects with same id can self-transfer and create misleading receipts/state
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer float months via int(months), changing repayment schedule without validation
compound_interest silently truncates non-integer float years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing results without validation
compound_interest does not reject negative principal
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the amount
fx_convert does not validate that rate is positive and finite, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates to create invalid conversions
